name: text/typewriter
title: Typewriter
title_vi: Gõ chữ từng ký tự, con trỏ nhấp nháy
desc_vi: Dòng chữ tự gõ ra từng ký tự theo nhịp, kèm con trỏ nhấp nháy ở cuối chữ vừa gõ.
params_vi: duration: thời gian gõ (1.2 s) · steps: số nhịp (0 = mỗi ký tự một nhịp) · caret: line | block | none · caretWidth · caretColor · blinkAt, blinkLow, blinkHalf, blinkRepeat: nhịp nhấp nháy
notes: Only the motion is ported. Source variables text / tone / font (monospace, 42px, colour tokens) belong to the film. Source reveals the line with max-width: progress x 100% on an overflow-hidden span, which works with a monospace font; here the typed part is real text (first k characters, k = round(progress x length)) next to an invisible span holding the rest, so any font works, no half glyphs, and the line never reflows. Ease steps(28) in the source is tuned to its 26-28 character line: param `steps` 0 means one step per character, set 28 to get the source value. Caret: source is an inline flex item (3 px rule or 22 px slab, gap 4 px) that takes layout space after the text; here it is a zero-width inline anchor with the bar drawn 4 px after the typed text (bar height 1em, centred on the line), so it never moves the text. Caret colour = the text colour (currentColor). The caret stays visible after the blink (source default).

elements.text: Làm phim chuyển động ngay trong code
